mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_book (book_name, author, publisher, isbn, category_id, cover_url, price, stock, total_count, borrow_count, location, description, create_time) VALUES (#{bookName}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{isbn}, #{categoryId}, #{coverUrl}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{totalCount}, 0, #{location}, #{description}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.category_name FROM t_book b LEFT JOIN t_category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id}

where.if: AND (b.book_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
